title: Speech by the Regional Commissioner of Arusha during the opening of the Seminar on Competition Advocacy, Combat of Counterfeit Goods, and Consumer Protection for Producers held at the Arusha Regional Commissioner's Office on February 23, 2023.
title_sw: HOTUBA YA MKUU WA MKOA WA ARUSHA WAKATI WA UFUNGUZI WA SEMINA YA UHAMASISHAJI WA MASUALA YA USHINDANI, UDHIBITI WA BIDHAA BANDIA NA KUMLINDA MLAJI KWA WAZALISHAJI KATIKA UKUMBI WA OFISI YA MKUU WA MKOA WA ARUSHA JIJINI ARUSHA TAREHE 23 FEBRUARI, 2023.
text:
HOTUBA YA MKUU WA MKOA WA ARUSHA WAKATI WA
UFUNGUZI WA SEMINA YA UHAMASISHAJI WA MASUALA YA
USHINDANI, UDHIBITI WA BIDHAA BANDIA NA KUMLINDA
MLAJI KWA WAZALISHAJI KATIKA UKUMBI WA OFISI YA
MKUU WA MKOA WA ARUSHA JIJINI ARUSHA TAREHE 23
FEBRUARI, 2023.
Mwakilishi wa Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa Tume ya Ushindani (FCC),
Mwenyekiti wa CTI Mkoa wa Arusha,
Wazalishaji (CTI),
Watendaji wa FCC,
Afisa Biashara kutoka Sekretarieti ya Mkoa wa Arusha,
Wanahabari,
Wageni waalikwa,
Mabibi na Mabwana.
Jamhuri ya Muungano!
Awali ya yote namshukuru Mwenyezi Mungu mwingi wa rehema na
fadhili kwa kutuwezesha kukutana katika shughuli hii tukiwa wazima
na wenye afya njema. Aidha, nitumie fursa hii kuwakaribisha sana
FCC, CTI na wageni wote mliotoka nje ya Mkoa wa Arusha, Karibuni
sana!
Serikali ya Mkoa wa Arusha ipo imara na tunawahakikishia ulinzi na
usalama pamoja na ushirikiano wa dhati katika shughuli za ujenzi wa
Taifa letu wakati wote mtakapokuwa hapa Arusha.
1

Kipekee nitumie fursa hii pia kuishukuru na kuipongeza Serikali ya
awamu ya sita inayoongozwa na Mhe. Dkt. Samia Suluhu Hassan,
Rais wa Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania, kwa jitihada kubwa
inazozifanya katika kuwaletea maendeleo watanzania wote ikiwa ni
pamoja na kuongeza tija zaidi katika Sekta ya Viwanda na Biashara
ikiwa ni pamoja na masuala ya Ushindani kwa ujumla.
Aidha, nawapongeza sana FCC kwa utekelezaji wa majukumu yenu
kwa mujibu wa Sheria hususan katika masuala ya ushindani, udhibiti
wa bidhaa bandia na kumlinda mlaji kwa ujumla. Haya ni masuala
muhimu sana, endapo tukishirikiana kwa dhati kuyasimamia vizuri na
kwa kuzingatia misingi ya Sheria, hapana shaka Sekta hii ya viwanda
na biashara itastawi na itaongeza tija zaidi katika nchi yetu.
Ndugu wanasemina, leo tumekusanyika mahali hapa kwa lengo kuu
la kupatiwa mafunzo yanayohusu majukumu ya Tume ya Ushindani,
Sheria ya Ushindani, udhibiti wa bidhaa bandia pamoja na wajibu wa
wazalishaji katika kumlinda mlaji. Nawashukuru sana FCC kwa kuona
umuhimu wa kutuletea semina hii katika Mkoa wetu wa Arusha. Ni
dhahiri mmefanya uamuzi sahihi kutokana na Mkoa wetu kuwa na
shughuli nyingi za uzalishaji, utalii na uchumi pia.
Aidha, nawapongeza sana FCC kwa hatua mnazochukua katika
kufanya semina hizi kwa lengo la kuwafikia watanzania wengi zaidi,
lakini bado mna kazi ya ziada katika kuhakikisha mnafanya semina
nyingi zaidi ili watanzania wenzetu ambao wengi wao ni wakulima,
wafanyabiashara na wazalishaji pia wanapata elimu za namna hii
kikamilifu ili kujiweka katika mazingira mazuri ya kiushindani kwa
2

mujibu wa taratibu na kanuni zilizopo. Serikali ya Mkoa wa Arusha
tutashirikiana nanyi kama ambavyo Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa FCC
amebainisha.
Ndugu wanasemina, nimefarijika sana kuona muitikio wenu mzuri
ambapo ninyi ndio wazalishaji, na mna umuhimu mkubwa sana katika
mstakabali wa ukuaji wa uchumi kuanzia ngazi ya kaya hadi Taifa. Ili
muweze kustawi katika shughuli zenu hamna budi kuzingatia taratibu
za nchi na kuzingatia misingi ya Ushindani. Hii ndio sababu ya FCC
kuona umuhimu wa kufanya semina hizi kwenu, hivyo, mna wajibu
wa kutumia fursa hii kwa umakini mkubwa ili baada ya mafunzo haya
tuone mabadiliko chanya yatakayokuwa na tija katika shughuli zenu
za uzalishaji na katika ngazi ya Taifa kwa ujumla.
Wanufaika wa semina ya leo ni wazalishaji, hivyo nitoe rai kwa
taasisi, asasi na wananchi wengine wanaojishughulisha na masuala
ya Ushindani kujenga utamaduni wa kutafuta elimu kwa kina kutoka
FCC na Idara nyingine za Serikali ikiwa ni pamoja na Shirika la
Viwanda Vidogo (SIDO), Shirika la Viwango Tanzania (TBS), Wakala
wa Usajili na Leseni za Biashara (BRELA), na Wakala wa Vipimo
(WMA). Msingi wa kutoa rai hii ni kwasababu Taasisi hizi ikiwa ni
pamoja na FCC ni vyombo muhimu katika ustawi wa biashara na
usimamizi wa soko nchini Tanzania, na endapo Taasisi hizi
zikitumiwa ipasavyo ni dhahiri tija katika kuanzisha, kulea na kukuza
biashara zenu itakuwa kubwa na ya kuridhisha.
Hivyobasi, kupitia Semina hii natoa maelekezo kwa Wakurugenzi wa
Halmashauri zote katika Mkoa wa Arusha kuhakikisha mnayabaini
3

makundi au vikundi ambavyo vinajihusisha na uzalishaji na
vinahudumiwa na Serikali kupitia Halmashauri zenu, hakikisheni
makundi hayo yanapata semina za namna hii ili kuongeza tija na
mnyororo wa thamani katika utekelezaji wa shughuli zao, na suala hili
litafanikiwa kwa kujenga ushirikiano wa kiutendaji na Taasisi hizo za
Serikali ikiwa ni pamoja na FCC ambayo kimsingi inafanya kazi nzuri
sana katika utoaji wa elimu kwa wadau mbalimbali wa maendeleo na
Umma kwa ujumla, pia inafanya kazi vizuri ya udhibiti wa bidhaa
bandia nchini kwa kufanya kaguzi katika maeneo mbalimbali ya nchi
pamoja maingilio ya bidhaa. kwa kushirikiana na Taasisi hizi naamini
shughuli za uzalishaji mali na uchumi kwa wananchi wetu vijijini na
hata mijini utakuwa salama na wenye tija kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya
wananchi wetu.
Hivyo basi, Wakurugenzi wote wa Mamlaka za Serikali za Mitaa
katika Mkoa wa Arusha hakikisheni mnakuwa na mpango kazi mzuri
utakaosaidia kuratibu mafunzo ya namna hii kwa ajili ya makundi yote
yanayonufaika na mikopo au fedha za Serikali zinazowagusa
wanawake, vijana na wenye ulemavu ambapo ni dhahiri
yatawajengea uwezo na weledi katika nyanja za uzalishaji, uuzaji,
ununuzi, utambuzi wa bidhaa bandia ikiwa ni pamoja na kujua misingi
bora ya ushindani wa soko na uchumi kwa ujumla. Aidha, utekelezaji
wa mpango kazi huo uzingatie kuzihusisha taasisi kama FCC katika
utoaji wa elimu.
Ndugu wanasemina, kupitia semina hii mtapokea mada mbalimbali
zitakazowajenga na kuwapa misingi muhimu juu ya biashara na
4

uchumi na mengine mengi yanayoakisi maendeleo katika shughuli
zenu za kila siku.
Hivyo ni vyema mkazingatia kwa makini fursa ya mafunzo haya ili
baada ya mafunzo haya tuone mabadiliko ikiwa ni pamoja na
kuzingatia maadili ya biashara ili kuhakikisha soko linabaki shindani,
bidhaa zinazopelekwa sokoni zinakidhi matarajio ya watumiaji au
wateja na taratibu za kupata faida zinazingatiwa na kuthamini utu wa
mtu, kuhakikisha mnawatendea haki wale mnaowapelekea bidhaa ili
wazinunue na kuzitumia kwa ajili ya kuendeleza uaminifu katika soko
ikiwa ni pamoja na kuwezesha upatikanaji wa ufanisi katika uchumi
wa soko, kujenga na kuimarisha mazingira sawa ya biashara katika
soko baina ya washindani, hayo yakifanikiwa bila shaka mtaweza
kushindana kwa vigezo vya ubora, bei, ubunifu na ufanisi.
Ndugu wanasemina, nimetaarifiwa kuwa kupitia semina hii pia
mtapata fursa ya kushauriana na kuelimishana kuhusu kazi za Tume
ya Ushindani (FCC) hususan katika masuala mbalimbali yanayohusu
udhibiti wa bidhaa bandia, ni vyema pia mkaitumia fursa hii vizuri kwa
kuwasilisha kero na changamoto mbalimbali mnazokabiliana nazo
katika shughuli zenu kwa watendaji wa FCC ili ziweze kupatiwa
majawabu yakinifu na kikamilifu.
Aidha, pamoja na juhudi hizi, ni vyema pia mkafanya jitihada ya
kutafuta masoko kupitia chama chenu (CTI) kwa kuzitumia Taasisi
mbalimbali za ndani na nje kwa msaada wa Mamlaka ya Usimamizi
na Maendeleo ya Biashara nchini, TANTRADE ili muweze kukuza
biashara zenu.
5

Naamini, ninyi ambao leo mmepata fursa ya semina hii, elimu
mtakayopata hapa mtakwenda kuwa mabalozi wazuri wa FCC katika
kuwaelimisha wananchi wengine ambao hawakupata fursa ya
kuhudhuria mafunzo haya.
Ndugu wanasemina, napenda kutumia fursa hii kwa niaba ya
Uongozi wa Serikali ya Mkoa wa Arusha kuwashukuru tena FCC kwa
kutuletea mafunzo haya hapa Arusha, nasi kama viongozi wa Serikali
na wananchi kwa ujumla tunawakaribisha tena wakati wowote
mtakaokuwa tayari kutuletea elimu za namna hii zenye maslahi
mapana kwa wananchi wetu na Taifa kwa ujumla hususan katika
masuala ya ushindani na ustawi wa uchumi.
Baada ya kusema hayo, nawatakia Semina njema na sasa natamka
kuwa Semina hii imefunguliwa rasmi.
Asanteni sana kwa kunisikiliza!
Speech by the Regional Commissioner of Arusha during the opening
of the Seminar on Competition Advocacy, Combat of Counterfeit
Goods, and Consumer Protection for Producers held at the Arusha
Regional Commissioner's Office on February 23, 2023.
Representative of the Director-General of the Fair Competition
Commission (FCC),
Chairman of the Confederation of Tanzania Industries (CTI) Arusha
Region,
6

Producers (CTI),
FCC Staff,
Trade Officer from the Arusha Regional Secretariat,
Journalists,
Invited Guests,
Ladies and Gentlemen.
First and foremost, I thank the Almighty God, full of mercy and grace,
for enabling us to meet in this event in good health. I also want to
warmly welcome the FCC, CTI, and all guests who have come from
outside the Arusha Region. Welcome!
The government of the Arusha Region is strong, and we assure you
of security, safety, and genuine cooperation in the development
activities of our nation throughout your stay here in Arusha.
I would like to use this opportunity to express my gratitude and
commendation to the sixth-phase government led by Her Excellency
Dr. Samia Suluhu Hassan, the President of the United Republic of
Tanzania, for the significant efforts it is making to bring development
to all Tanzanians, including enhancing productivity in the sectors of
investment, industry, and trade, including overall competition issues.
Furthermore, I commend the FCC for the effective implementation of
its duties according to the law, especially in matters of competition,
combat of counterfeit goods, and the overall protection of consumers.
7

These are crucial issues, and if we collaborate sincerely to oversee
them in accordance with the principles of the law, undoubtedly, this
sector of Industry, and Trade will thrive and contribute even more to
our country.
Seminar participants, today we have gathered here with the main
objective of receiving training on the roles of the Fair Competition
Commission, the Competition Act, combat of counterfeit goods, and
the responsibility of producers in protecting consumers. I thank the
FCC for recognizing the importance of bringing this seminar to our
Arusha Region. It is evident that you have made the right decision
considering the numerous production, tourism, and economic
activities taking place in our region.
Moreover, I congratulate the FCC for taking steps to conduct these
seminars with the aim of reaching a larger audience. However, there
is still extra work to be done to ensure that more seminars are held to
provide comprehensive education to our fellow Tanzanians, most of
whom are farmers, traders, and producers. This will enable them to
fully understand and position themselves in a competitive
environment according to the existing laws and regulations. The
Arusha Regional Government will collaborate with you, as mentioned
by the Director-General of the FCC.
Seminar participants, I am pleased to see your positive response,
especially since you are the producers, and you play a crucial role in
the future of economic growth, from household to national levels. To
prosper in your activities, it is imperative to adhere to the country's
8

regulations and principles of competition. This is why the FCC deems
it important to conduct these seminars for you. Therefore, you have a
role to carefully use this opportunity so that, after this training,
positive changes can be observed in your production activities and at
the national level.
The beneficiaries of today's seminar are the producers, so I urge
institutions, organizations, and other citizens engaged in competition
issues to cultivate a culture of seeking in-depth knowledge from the
FCC and other government departments, including the Small
Industries Development Organization (SIDO), Tanzania Bureau of
Standards (TBS), Business Registrations and Licensing Agency
(BRELA), and Weights and Measures Agency (WMA). I advise this
matter because these institutions, including the FCC, are crucial
bodies for the prosperity of business and market regulation in
Tanzania. If utilized properly, they will undoubtedly contribute
significantly to initiating, nurturing, and growing your businesses,
providing satisfactory results.
Therefore, all Directors of Local Government Authorities in the
Arusha Region should ensure that you identify groups or associations
involved in production and are served by the government through
your councils. Ensure that these groups receive training of this nature
to increase efficiency and value chain in their activities. This can be
achieved by building operational partnerships with these government
institutions, including the FCC, which, fundamentally, does an
excellent job in providing education to various development
stakeholders and the public at large. It also effectively controls
9

counterfeit goods in the country by conducting inspections in various
areas and entry points. Through cooperation with these institutions, I
believe the economic activities of our citizens, both in rural and urban
areas, will be safe and productive for the development of our people.
Therefore, all Directors of Local Government Authorities in the
Arusha Region should ensure that you have a good work plan to
coordinate the implementation of training for all groups benefiting
from government loans or funds that affect women, youth, and people
with disabilities. This training will undoubtedly empower them with
skills and expertise in production, sales, procurement, identification of
counterfeit goods, and understanding the principles of market
competition and the economy as a whole. Additionally, the
implementation of this work plan should consider involving institutions
such as the FCC in providing education.
Seminar participants, through this seminar, will receive various topics
that will build and provide essential foundations on business and the
economy, among other aspects that reflect progress in your daily
activities. Therefore, it is crucial that you pay careful attention to the
training opportunities presented here. After this training, positive
changes should be seen, including adhering to business ethics. This
is to ensure that the market remains competitive, products entering
the market meet consumer expectations, and profit-making
procedures are ethical and respect human dignity. Ensure that you
treat fairly those to whom you deliver products so that they can buy
and use them to maintain trust in the market and facilitate the
efficiency of the market economy, create and strengthen equal
10

business environments in the market among competitors. If
successful, you will undoubtedly compete based on quality, price,
innovation, and efficiency.
Seminar participants, I have been informed that through this seminar,
you will also have the opportunity to consult and educate each other
about the FCC functions, especially in various issues related to the
combat of counterfeit goods. It is essential to use this opportunity well
by presenting challenges and difficulties you face in your activities to
FCC officials so that they can be addressed comprehensively and
efficiently.
Furthermore, despite these efforts, it is also essential to make an
effort to seek markets through your association (CTI) by utilizing
various internal and external institutions with the assistance of the
Tanzania Trade Development Authority (TANTRADE) to grow your
businesses.
I believe those of you who have had the opportunity to attend this
seminar today will become good ambassadors of the FCC, educating
other citizens who did not have the chance to attend such training.
Seminar participants, I would like to use this opportunity, on behalf of
the Arusha Regional Government leadership, to thank the FCC once
again for this training. We, as government leaders and citizens in
general, welcome you anytime you are ready to bring us education
that is broadly beneficial to our people and the nation, particularly in
matters of competition and economic well-being.
11

After saying that, I wish
this
Thank
you a successful seminar, and I now declare
seminar officially open.
you very much for listening!
